label: run138 measured storage uncredited
definition: Step 2: run134 recipe on the current code with NO 2023 reserve credits (load from 2024, storage-reserve from 2025). Surfaces an interaction missed at first: storage_as_commitment caps battery dispatch by the storage-AS series for ALL years (unscoped), so main's measured 2023 storage (1.25 GW, replacing the 0.83 GW estimate) holds more battery out of energy and TIGHTENS 2023 — 49.8 (run134, old estimate) -> 58.4 (210/130), now OVER actual 48.4 (181/104). 2024/2025 unchanged (33.8/38.0; their storage was already measured). So measured storage over-heats 2023; the offsetting lever is the 2023 load-resource reserve credit (run139, the KEEPER, which corrects this to MAE 12.1). This run is the uncredited PROBE that isolates the storage-commitment over-tightening.
